```yaml
name: Validate PR

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  validate-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run PR validation
        id: pr-validation
        uses: getsentry/github-workflows/.github/actions/validate-pr@v1.0.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          maintainers-file: '.github/maintainers.yml'
          contribution-guidelines-url: 'https://docs.sentry.io/contributing/'
          draft-status-enforced: true

      - name: Check if PR is valid
        if: ${{ steps.pr-validation.outputs.valid == 'true' }}
        run: echo "PR is valid."

      - name: Check if PR is invalid
        if: ${{ steps.pr-validation.outputs.valid == 'false' }}
        run: echo "PR is invalid."
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Add PR to project
        if: ${{ steps.pr-validation.outputs.valid == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/add-to-project@v1.0.2
        with:
          project-url: 'https://github.com/org/repo/projects/1'
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          labeled: true
          label-operator: OR
```
